## AI Jarvis governed release checklist

- [ ] Scope and affected systems are identified.
- [ ] Read-only discovery was completed first.
- [ ] Backup and rollback path is documented.
- [ ] Secrets use least privilege and are not committed.
- [ ] Tests and health checks pass.
- [ ] Security and dependency findings were reviewed.
- [ ] Documentation and provenance were updated.
- [ ] Affiliate disclosures are present where applicable.
- [ ] Production, billing, and public-publishing approval is recorded.
